# `nullif`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns null if `expr1` equals to `expr2`, or `expr1` otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
nullif(expr1, expr2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- nullif, example 1
> SELECT nullif(2, 2);
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
